protocol.empty_buckets: empty dict; counts recorded for nonempty buckets
protocol.history: PAD and full seen_ids excluded; repeated target retained
protocol.oracle: post-hoc loo_val future-available cohort; same checkpoint and seeded candidates
protocol.popularity: train-count weights; zero counts excluded; empty eligible mass raises
protocol.ranking: score descending, ties by item ID ascending (common Evaluator)
protocol.sampled_metrics: HR@10 and NDCG@10 only; no sampled MRR available from shared engine
protocol.sampling: 100 draws WITH replacement; duplicate negatives count separately
protocol.selection: standard Full-Ranking validation NDCG@10, never Oracle
protocol.temporal: existing preprocessing: split-specific frequencies; full global catalogue
